audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill / Olaf / Olaf / Skill / Skill / Olaf / Olaf. The packet chart reads Olaf / Olaf / Skill / Olaf / Neeko / Skill / Olaf — and the packet chart is the one that matches the page's own whys line for line: whys[0] 'walks me down before I have any combo at level 1' (Olaf, not Skill), whys[2] 'genuinely contestable' (Skill, not Olaf), whys[3] 'I concede 4-5' (Olaf, not Skill), whys[4] 'my one clean kill window' (Neeko, not Skill), whys[5] "it's a coinflip" (Skill, not Olaf).
audit.why: The sides look like they were written one row out of step with the reasons underneath them. Five of seven rows currently render a verdict that its own explanation contradicts.
audit.corrected: Olaf / Olaf / Skill / Olaf / Neeko / Skill / Olaf, as matched full+content pairs with ratings moved on the four rows that changed hands.

audit.why: spikes[] has four entries with sound timings: his Level 1-2 walk-down, her Level 3 root window, her Level 6 Pop Blossom, and the Ragnarok window. The Level 6 spike is the only Neeko row on the chart and now the chart says so.
audit.corrected: Kept the timings; corrected the ability facts inside spikes[3].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabrications run through the whole page. (1) DASHES: tldr, winCon, dosFull[0].t, dontsFull[0].t, tradeBad, dontsFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.trading, report[0].t, report[1].t, report[3].t and report[11].t all build the game plan around baiting Olaf's dash and rooting his landing spot. Olaf has no dash and no leap — Berserker Rage is attack speed and life steal, Undertow is a thrown axe, Tough It Out is attack speed and a shield, Reckless Swing is a 325-range hit, Ragnarok is disable immunity. The entire stated win condition is aimed at an ability that does not exist. (2) SHIELD: whys[6], spikes[3].text, mid and wants.foe[2] say his true damage 'ignores your wind-up shield' and that Ragnarok 'ignores my shield'. Neeko has no shield in her kit at all.
audit.why: A player told to bait a dash will hold Tangle-Barbs waiting for a movement that never comes, then get walked down by the axe slow they were never told to respect. A player told they have a shield will price an all-in around damage absorption they do not have.
audit.corrected: Olaf closes on foot behind Undertow's slow (1000 range, flat 9s, and the cooldown RESETS if he picks the axe back up — standing on the axe is the real counterplay, which the page already gets right in dosFull[0].d). Reckless Swing is true damage at 325 range on 11/10/9/8/7s and costs him health, refunded if it kills. Ragnarok makes him immune to disables only while he keeps attacking, 100/90/80s — your root and Pop Blossom stun are dead inside it — and its passive armour and MR blunt your burst even when he never presses it.

audit.why: Undertow is a flat 9s at every rank, and resets outright on pickup. Fifteen seconds sells a punish window that is both too long and, if he retrieves the axe, not there at all.
audit.corrected: Nine seconds — and only if he leaves the axe on the ground.

notes: DERIVED-FLAG MISFIRE, DELIBERATELY NOT WRITTEN: the kit file tags Undertow with 'grounding: shuts off enemy dashes', and missingInteractions key 30 builds on it with 'Olaf can deny your mobility (Pop Blossom (R)) with Undertow (Q)'. Riot's own description of Undertow says only that it deals damage and reduces Armor and Move Speed — no grounding, no dash denial. Per the standing rule I trusted the description over the flag and put nothing about grounding on the page. If Undertow really does ground in 26.15, that is a genuinely high-value line for this matchup and worth adding on confirmation.
